title: Traeger Announces Reporting Date for Third Quarter Fiscal 2025 Financial Results
summary: Traeger, Inc. (“Traeger”) (NYSE: COOK), creator and category leader of the wood pellet grill, today announced that it will release its third quarter fiscal 2025 financial results after market close on Wednesday, November 5, 2025. Management will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results. Those who wish to participate in the call may do so by dialing (833) 470-1428 or +1 (646) 844-6383 for international callers, conference ID 513369. To pre-register for the conference call, please visit Traeger Third Quarter Fiscal 2025 Earnings Conference Call . The conference call will also be webcast live at https://investors.traeger.com . For those unable to participate, a replay of the conference call will be available approximately two hours after the conclusion of the call until Wednesday, November 5, 2025. To access the telephone replay please dial (866) 813-9403, conference ID 489606. A replay of the webcast will also be available approximately two hours
